app.title: Krishi Scan
app.subtitle: Crop disease detection for Indian farmers

home.howto: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf and we will check the photo quality, find the likely disease, show you which part of the leaf led to the result, and give you next steps - all in your language.
home.illustration: Take or upload a clear photo of the affected leaf to start.

offline.online: Online - data will be saved to the server.
offline.offline: Offline - diagnoses are saved on this device and will sync automatically.
offline.first_run_online_required: To set up Krishi Scan offline, open this app once while connected to the internet so the model and language files can be downloaded. After that you can use it fully offline.
offline.waiting_for_model: Preparing the crop model on this device (one time)...

farmer.title: Farmer details
farmer.name: Your name
farmer.not_saved: Not saved yet — add your details below

diagnose.title: Diagnose a crop
diagnose.photo_method: How will you take the photo?
diagnose.capture_hint: Place one affected leaf on a plain, well-lit background, close to the camera.
diagnose.upload_hint: Choose a clear photo of the affected leaf.
diagnose.new_test: Start a new test with a different photo
diagnose.start_another: Tip: you can start another diagnosis any time with a new photo.
diagnose.cam_guide: Keep one clean leaf centered and filling most of the frame, on a plain background.

gatekeeper.title: Photo quality check
gatekeeper.unreadable: The photo could not be read. Please take another photo.
gatekeeper.blur: The photo is blurry or shaken.
gatekeeper.blur_hint: Hold the phone steady or rest it on something, then retake.
gatekeeper.dark_hint: Move to a well-lit place or switch on a light, then retake.
gatekeeper.bright: The photo is too bright or overexposed.
gatekeeper.bright_hint: Move out of direct sunlight or into shade, then retake.
gatekeeper.leaf: Not enough of the leaf is visible.
gatekeeper.leaf_hint: Zoom in so one leaf fills most of the frame, then retake.
gatekeeper.glare: Too much glare / reflection in the photo.
gatekeeper.glare_hint: Change the angle to avoid reflections, then retake.
gatekeeper.retakes_left: You can still retake {n} more time(s).
gatekeeper.low_confidence_warning: Warning: this photo did not pass the quality check. The diagnosis may be less accurate. Please take it as a starting point only.
gatekeeper.would_you_like_retake: Would you like to retake the photo?

classifier.title: Diagnosis
classifier.heatmap: Which part of the leaf drove this result
classifier.heatmap_hint: The bright red regions are where the model found the strongest disease signs.
classifier.not_confident: The model is not confident about this image.
classifier.outside_training: This may be a crop or condition outside the model's training data. Please show the leaf to a local agriculture officer or use a government helpline before treating.
classifier.model_warning: Demo mode: a fine-tuned model checkpoint was not found, so results come from a baseline model and are for testing the app flow only.
classifier.crop_uncovered: Note: our model is not trained on {crop} yet. The result below may be unreliable - please confirm with a local agriculture officer. Covered crops: {covered}.
classifier.covered_crops: apple, blueberry, cherry, corn, grape, orange, peach, bell pepper, potato, raspberry, soybean, squash, strawberry, tomato
classifier.crop_mismatch: You selected {crop}, but the strongest pattern this photo matches is actually {matched}. Double-check that the photo shows the selected crop.
classifier.healthy_explanation: This was read as a healthy leaf ({label}). Healthy leaves of different crops look very similar, so this is a low-risk diagnosis. If the leaf actually looks damaged, retake a close-up of the affected area instead.
classifier.tie_explanation: {a} and {b} are close ({pa}% vs {pb}%). The model sees the leaf as similar to both - use the heatmap and your soil/weather notes to decide.
classifier.why_hint: These are the model's top matches and the area of the leaf it based them on.

soil.title: Soil details (optional)
soil.skip: Skip - I only have a photo
soil.saved_used: Using the soil values saved on the Soil page.
soil.saved_updated: Soil values saved to your profile for future tests.
soil.saved_none: No saved soil values yet - enter them below or skip.
soil.save_no_phone: Add your phone number on the Home page so soil values can be saved to your profile.
soil.saved_failed: Could not save to your profile right now - try again later.
soil.units_note: Values in kg/ha for N, P, K; pH is a number between 0 and 14.
soil.capture_shc: Take a photo of the Soil Health Card
soil.upload_shc: Upload a photo of the Soil Health Card
soil.ocr_result: These values were read from your card.
soil.ocr_confirm_prompt: Please check them and confirm, or correct before continuing.
soil.edit: I want to correct a value
soil.invalid: The card could not be read clearly. You can try again or enter the values by hand.
soil.saved: Soil values saved and will be used for this diagnosis.
soil.npk_note: N, P, K are recorded for your report and give agronomic guidance - they do not change the disease ranking below (only temperature, humidity and pH do).
soil.low_n: Nitrogen low (N={value}): expect yellowing leaves; consider a nitrogen top-dressing.
soil.high_n: Nitrogen high (N={value}): lush growth and pest risk; follow crop-specific limits.
soil.low_p: Phosphorus low (P={value}): slow root growth and purple tinge possible.
soil.high_p: Phosphorus high (P={value}): can lock up micronutrients.
soil.low_k: Potassium low (K={value}): weak stems and yellow leaf edges.

weather.title: Weather (optional)
weather.use_farmer_location: Use the location saved for me
weather.gps_fail: Could not detect your location automatically. You can enter your place by hand below.
weather.failed: Could not reach the weather service. Continuing with the photo diagnosis only - weather was not used.
weather.not_used: Weather was not added - the result uses the photo (and soil, if given) only.

fusion.title: Combined result (soil + weather + photo)
fusion.no_data: No soil or weather data given - the photo result stands alone.
fusion.disclaimer: Environmental ranges are from plant-pathology reference tables and only help tell similar diseases apart.

reco.title: What to do next
reco.not_sure: If you are unsure, always ask a local agriculture officer before applying any pesticide.
reco.treat_hint: What to use for this result and when to apply it.
reco.treat_disclaimer: Doses are general guidance. Confirm the currently-approved product and dose at your agri-input dealer, and always ask a local agriculture officer before spraying.

history.title: My diagnoses
history.empty: No diagnoses yet. Take your first crop photo on the Diagnose page.
history.sync_hint: Diagnoses are saved on this device and will sync to the cloud automatically when you are back online.

about.title: Help & about
about.offline_text: Krishi Scan works without internet after the first setup. Diagnoses made offline are saved on your phone and sent to the server automatically when you are back online.
about.disclaimer_text: Krishi Scan gives guidance only. It is not a replacement for a trained agriculture officer. Always confirm before using pesticides.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

wx.report_no_env: No weather or soil data recorded
wx.report_footer: Generated with Krishi Scan - guidance only, confirm with an agriculture officer before treating.
wx.explain_body: The leaf photo most closely matches {disease}. You can see the exact area the app focused on in the heatmap below.
wx.explain_terms_body: This means the signs on your leaf look most like {disease}. It is a common {tmp} condition. Treating it early usually gives the best result.
wx.close_call: The top two results are very close ({a} {pa}% vs {b} {pb}%). Look at the heatmap or ask your officer to decide which fits best.
